timing: Actual offline analysis execution registration AFTER measurement; not backdated preregistration

original_registration.inspection_boundary: Operational progress and guard incidents already inspected; no aggregate outcome contrast computed by this export
original_registration.main_set: All complete valid six-method blocks; block 1 includes explicitly authorized replacement and is marked cross-period recovered
original_registration.sensitivity_set: Same complete-block rules, exclude block 1 regardless of results
original_registration.unit: paired block on one Pi, not independent rows/windows/power frames
original_registration.statistics: For both sets: method-paired block differences, Student-t 95% CI, n and block IDs; raw and preceding-idle-adjusted energy/power; report detector/deadline/backlog outcomes separately
original_registration.missing: No imputation or incomplete block pairing; if fewer than two complete blocks, report effect descriptively and CI unavailable
original_registration.original_rule: CAMPAIGN_PLAN.md section 8 requires paired-block Student-t 95% CI and both raw/idle-adjusted reporting; physical lock fixes ten blocks and guard rules
original_registration.difference: Excluding recovered block 1 is an additional sensitivity analysis, not a change to original acceptance rules or a substitute primary result
original_registration.precedence: Any more specific frozen rule takes precedence; document conflict before analysis, never silently change it

later_registration: Block 5 is now also cross-period recovered. Preserve the registered all-block and exclude-block-1 analyses; additionally report exclusion of all recovered blocks {1,5}, regardless of outcome. This does not change validity rules.
contrasts: All 15 unordered method pairs, fixed lexicographic method order; difference first minus second
inference: Block-level paired mean, sample SD, Student-t 95% CI; nominal unadjusted multiple-comparison intervals; descriptive sensitivity, no confirmatory significance claim
added_implementation_detail: All-pairs enumeration and exported diagnostic metrics specified now, not claimed as originally predeclared
old_evidence: Historical V1/P0/P1/R1/R2 excluded from all new-study statistics; references only
